description: This file defines the GuardTokenParser class, a final class that extends AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing 'guard' tags within Twig templates. It handles conditional logic based on whether certain guard types (function, filter, test) exist in the environment and returns appropriate node structures for further compilation or rendering. The class includes methods for parsing tokens, deciding token boundaries, and identifying the tag name.

classes.name: GuardTokenParser
classes.description: A final class responsible for parsing 'guard' tags in Twig templates, enabling conditional inclusion or exclusion of content based on environment guard checks.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'guard' tag token sequence, verifies guard type existence, and constructs corresponding Node objects based on the presence or absence of the guard.

methods.name: decideGuardFork
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates a fork in guard block ('else' or 'endguard').

methods.name: decideGuardEnd
methods.description: Checks if the token marks the end of the guard block ('endguard').

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'guard'.
